{"metadata":{"description":"TaskSwarm (蜂群) — DeepSeek Harness 上的多智能体任务编排插件：waves/lanes 并行执行、git worktree 隔离、任务包与跨模型评审、崩溃可恢复 | Multi-agent task orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: waves/lanes parallel execution, git worktree isolation, task packets, cross-model review, crash recovery","id":"gh:1333800488","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-taskswarm","slug":"february2015/dsh-taskswarm","topics":["ai-agents","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","git-worktree","multi-agent","taskplane"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"TaskSwarm (蜂群) — DeepSeek Harness 上的多智能体任务编排插件：waves/lanes 并行执行、git worktree 隔离、任务包与跨模型评审、崩溃可恢复 | Mu"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"lti-agent task orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: waves/lanes parallel execution, git worktree isol"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ation, task packets, cross-model review, crash recovery"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# TaskSwarm（蜂群）"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> ⚠️ **Temporary install notice (Aug 17–18, 2026)**: the npm package `dsh-taskswarm` was fully unpub"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"lished to clean up old versions and is subject to a 24-hour cool-down (npm's anti-squatting protecti"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"on). **For Aug 17 and Aug 18, install from GitHub**:
> `dsh plugin add https://github.com/february20"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"15/dsh-taskswarm.git`
> **Starting Aug 19, the npm package is back**: `dsh plugin add dsh-taskswarm`"},{"id":"p3s5","text":". This notice will be removed then."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Multi-agent task orchestration for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"TaskSwarm arranges a batch of tasks into dependency-ordered **waves**, runs multiple AI workers in *"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"*parallel lanes** isolated by git worktrees, then automatically reviews and merges their output."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> 蜂群 (fēngqún) is a swarm of bees: the queen directs, the workers each buzz on their own task in par"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"allel — exactly what this project does: **the supervisor plans the waves, then every worker advances"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"t this project does: **the supervisor plans the waves, then every worker advances in its own lane**."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **License:** MIT
- **Upstream:** TaskPlane（Pi ecosystem multi-agent orchestration）— this project i"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"s a native port
- **中文文档:** README.zh-CN.md"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Waves / Lanes parallel orchestration** — tasks are topologically layered by their dependency DAG"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" into waves; tasks within a wave run concurrently
- **Git worktree isolation** — every task (lane) w"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"orks in its own worktree; results are merged into the `taskswarm/orch` integration branch
- **Task p"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ackets** — each task is a `PROMPT.md` (mission / steps / constraints) + `STATUS.md` (progress), givi"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ng workers durable memory across context resets
- **Checkpoint discipline** — automatic git commits "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"at step boundaries; a crashed worker never loses committed work
- **Cross-model review** — an indepe"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ndent reviewer scores each task per its `Review Level`; PASS merges, REVISE sends it back for revisi"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"on
- **File mailbox** — workers and supervisor communicate asynchronously (notify / escalate / reque"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"st) without shared context
- **Conversational supervisor** — shares your session: reports wave compl"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"etion, lane failures, batch completion; takes verbal commands (start / pause / abort / integrate / o"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"pen dashboard); notifications and the prompt are **bilingual (中文 / English)** — say "use English" to"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" switch, auto-detected from your session language, persisted to `.taskswarm/config.json` across rest"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"arts
- **Web Dashboard** — local realtime dashboard, zero-dependency node:http + SSE, multiple insta"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"nces with automatic port negotiation. **Auto-starts when a batch starts and prints the link in chat*"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"* — one dashboard per workspace, ever (an already-running instance is reused, never duplicated)
- **"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"Crash-recoverable** — durable disk state + checkpoints + retained lane branches; after a kill/restar"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"t you can salvage work, clean up residue, and re-run
- **Orch-based lane baselines** — every lane wo"},{"id":"p9s18","text":"rktree is created from the `taskswarm/orch` integration HEAD, so it inherits all previously merged o"},{"id":"p9s19","text":"utput instead of re-inventing shared code
- **Task-packet validation** — `/tswarm-check` + `npm run "},{"id":"p9s20","text":"check:tasks` surface malformed packets (bad IDs, missing steps/criteria) with actionable causes inst"},{"id":"p9s21","text":"ead of silently skipping them
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Why TaskSwarm, when DSH already has subagents?"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"DSH's native `subagent` / `workflow` / `goal` are *conversational, one-shot* scheduling — great for
"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ad-hoc delegation. TaskSwarm is a **project-level orchestration layer** on top of them:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"|               | DSH native subagents              | TaskSwarm                                     "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"                                                  |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Task shape    | one sentence in chat              | **task packets** (PROMPT.md / STATUS.md) — ver"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"sioned, batchable, reusable                       |
| Parallelism   | manual                        "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"    | **wave planning**: dependency-topological waves, parallel lanes per wave                      "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"  |
| Isolation     | shared workspace (writes collide) | **git worktree isolation**: per-lane branc"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"h + checkpoints, merged into `taskswarm/orch`         |
| Quality gate  | none                      "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"        | **independent Reviewer** (PASS / REVISE)                                                  "},{"id":"p13s7","text":"      |
| Resumability  | gone when the process ends        | **durable batch state** (`.taskswarm/b"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"atches/*.json`): restart / resume / skip finished lanes   |
| Observability | watch the chat        "},{"id":"p13s9","text":"            | **supervisor event reports + Web Dashboard**, auto-started with the batch, link printe"},{"id":"p13s10","text":" | **supervisor event reports + Web Dashboard**, auto-started with the batch, link printed in chat |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Quick Start"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 1. Install (pick one)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Restart dsh web** after installing — the plugin takes effect on boot."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> **Upgrading an existing install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-taskswarm`
> reports "Already"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" up to date" and stays on the old version when the lockfile

> `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-taskswarm@<new-version>`"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" (or run
> `pnpm update --latest` in the profile directory), then restart dsh web."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How It Works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Four roles are orchestrated:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Role           | Responsibility                                                                   "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"     | Responsibility                                                                              |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| **Supervisor** | Plans waves, schedules lanes, handles events, talks to you (the session that ran "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"`/tswarm`) |
| **Worker**     | One DSH agent per task, advancing its task packet step by step in an"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" isolated lane worktree |
| **Reviewer**   | Independent agent reviewing worker output, emitting PAS"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"S / REVISE                           |
| **Merger**     | Merges finished lane output into the `task"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"swarm/orch` integration branch                    |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**Git model:**"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Durable state** (`<repo>/.taskswarm/`):"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":true}
